message.content:
Deep audit all 10 landing page components in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/src/components/landing/ for UI quality, accessibility, responsiveness, and production issues.

For EACH component, check:
1. Mobile responsiveness — does the layout break on small screens? Are there proper breakpoints?
2. Accessibility — proper aria labels, semantic HTML, color contrast, keyboard navigation
3. Typography consistency — are font sizes, weights, colors consistent with the design system?
4. Spacing/alignment — any inconsistent padding/margin patterns?
5. Animation quality — are framer-motion animations smooth? Any jank risks?
6. Edge cases — long text overflow, empty states, browser compatibility
7. Performance — unnecessary re-renders, heavy DOM elements
8. Dark mode compatibility — since the app has dark mode CSS vars, check if landing sections handle this
9. Color consistency — are hardcoded colors (like "bg-indigo-600") used instead of CSS variables?
10. Link behavior — do anchor links (#how-it-works, #pillars) work? Are internal links using React Router Link?

Also read these files:
